## Checklist

See `CONTRIBUTING.md` for what each of these means.

- [ ] I ran the whole procedure, start to finish, on real material
- [ ] I ran it more than once, and the playbook reflects what differed/broke between runs
- [ ] The procedure has at least one explicit human checkpoint
- [ ] Every number in "Defaults" has a stated source
- [ ] No real names, file paths, or client/project identifiers anywhere in this PR
- [ ] `status` in the frontmatter honestly reflects how many times this has run
